_comment: catalog/fly-work-procs.json — how bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh reads its ps probe (BH-6877).
Before it stops a pool, builder or lane-run machine, the reaper runs `flyctl machine exec <mid> 'ps -eo pcpu=,args='`.
Each entry is a fixed substring of the process command line. A `work` match makes the machine busy. A process that
matches no `idle` entry and uses at least fly.probe_busy_cpu_pct CPU makes it busy. Only idle-listed or quiet processes
let the stop go ahead. `work` is checked first. A probe that fails or prints a line that is not '<pcpu> <args>' is unknown,
never idle. A file that does not validate turns every probe-based stop off for the pass (alert fly-idle-reaper-procs).
